cases.prompt: Update an existing package in an NixOS/nixpkgs checkout to a new upstream release.
must_do: verify the target checkout, branch, package path, and current revision
inspect upstream release notes, lock data, metadata, patches, and affected tests
run layered package validation and prepare a nixpkgs PR packet
must_not_do: treat a version-and-hash edit as sufficient evidence
push or open a PR without approval

cases.prompt: A nixpkgs package is broken because an upstream fix is merged but not released; repair it with a justified backport.
must_do: reproduce and locate the first failing boundary
use an immutable upstream source and record the patch removal condition
separate build, package-test, nixpkgs-review, and runtime evidence
must_not_do: hide the failure with doCheck=false or an unexplained dependency
retain a patch without an expiry condition

cases.prompt: Add a missing upstream application to NixOS/nixpkgs.
must_do: check project maturity, license, usefulness, maintenance commitment, and current package layout
verify source provenance, builder, metadata, install output, and basic tests
include maintainers, affected platforms, and any required package tests in the review packet
must_not_do: copy machine-specific overlay wiring into nixpkgs
guess a license, hash, or main program

cases.prompt: Review a nixpkgs package pull request for correctness without editing the checkout.
must_do: report findings by location and severity with evidence
check source, metadata, tests, package output, rebuild impact, and patch lifecycle
state missing validation and stop before modifications
must_not_do: apply fixes or rewrite the contributor branch
call a dry-build a live runtime test

cases.prompt: Turn a working local derivation into a contribution to NixOS/nixpkgs.
must_do: identify and remove local machine or consumer assumptions
compare with current nixpkgs conventions and package anatomy
validate the upstream-shaped package and document remaining runtime boundaries
must_not_do: assume the local overlay is already nixpkgs quality
submit without responsible-person review and required disclosure
